data.name: SRCNatura Sure
data.description: SRCNatura Sure Pvt Ltd is an India-based project developer that registered the first Verra VCS biochar carbon removal project (VCS4679, "Project Reignite"), operating with roughly 5,000 smallholder farmers in Odisha in partnership with Dutch developer Carboneers. The project aims to remove approximately 110,760 tCO2e annually by converting agricultural waste into biochar for application to farmland.
